messages:
sarah-sales: Heads-up — onboarding call with Oakmont Bank tomorrow 10:30am. POC checklist: EU-only data residency, BYOK (customer-managed KMS), and deterministic routing pinned to an EU region. They specifically asked for sub-processor list and proof of no cross-border failover. Can we get a short summary I can read on the call?

alex-presales: Short answer: hosted API = regional preference not guaranteed; Dedicated or Private = can be pinned to EU. BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private with KMS integration work. I can summarize constraints.

matt-eng: Quick details from infra: Hosted -> we prefer EU regions but under capacity constraints requests may route briefly to nearest compatible region (not suitable for strict sovereignty). Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) -> can provision and pin to eu-west1/eu-central1. Private VPC/on-prem -> full control. BYOK: supported via customer KMS w/ key-wrapping, requires onboarding and key policy review.

sarah-sales: They also asked about egress certs and a guarantee that data won't be replicated to non-EU sites. Any language we can commit to?

matt-eng: For absolute non-replication we'd recommend Private on-prem or VPC + Dedicated in single EU region. For hosted we replicate minimal control-plane metadata for reliability; we can document what is stored/replicated. We can provide audit logs for data access and transfers.

nina-legal: Subprocessors: current EU-affiliated subprocessors include LogSafe (logging), Observr (metrics), and CloudGX (infra). For enterprise finance customers we'll provide DPA + up-to-date subprocessor attestation and we can surface SOC2/ISO reports. If they require SCCs/adequacy references we can add that.

sarah-sales: Can someone draft two one-liners I can read during the call: one for Hosted, one for Dedicated? Must be conservative and legally safe.

matt-eng: Hosted: "Redwood will process customer data primarily in EU regions; in rare events of capacity shortage requests may be routed to the nearest compatible Redwood region; Redwood will notify the customer and provide remediation options."

matt-eng: Dedicated: "Redwood will provision dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region; data and processing will remain within the specified region except for control-plane metadata necessary for platform operation and auditing."

nina-legal: Suggest adding: "Customer may request DPA and current subprocessor list; Redwood will provide attestation and standard compliance documentation on request."

alex-presales: Notes on pricing/ops: Dedicated + BYOK + extended retention are add-ons. @maria-pricing can you give a back-of-envelope for a 2x A100 dedicated pool + KMS integration + attestation? We need approx numbers for procurement.

maria-pricing: Ballpark: one-time setup ~ $38k, committed monthly ~ $17k, KMS integration & attestation add-on ~$5k/year. Rough — final depends on token/throughput profile.

sarah-sales: Great. Also need to surface the onboarding timeline for KMS: how long to validate customer key and finish attestation?

matt-eng: Typical KMS onboarding: 2-3 weeks (key exchange, policy validation, test decrypts). If they want air-gapped/on-prem, add 4-6 weeks for deployment.

oz-ops: Quick ops checklist I'm going to attach to PROJ ticket: 1) Confirm exact EU region (eu-west1 vs eu-central1) 2) Confirm BYOK key rotation + KMS endpoint/IP allowlist 3) Provide subprocessor attestation 4) SLO/penalty items 5) IP whitelisting & egress certs 6) Compliance docs deliverable timeline. I've created PROJ-9821 for handoff.

sarah-sales: Can we also give a tiny sample routing policy snippet so they see what 'pin to region' looks like?

matt-eng: Example (Dedicated pinned routing):

```\n{\"routing\": {\"mode\": \"pin\", \"region\": \"eu-west1\", \"fallback\": \"none\"}}\n```

matt-eng: Note: "fallback: none" is only possible for Dedicated/Private. Hosted policies use "preference" with automatic fallback.

alex-presales: For the call I'll present: summary bullets, the two commitment lines, high-level pricing, and timeline. After the call we'll open PROJ-9821 (ops) and a pricing quote request.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket PROJ-9821 and assigned to @oz-ops.

sarah-sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll run this on the call and post notes + customer asks afterwards. :thumbsup:
